changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwexternaltest AS SELECT et.id, et.facility_name, et.test_id, et.reason, et.created_by, et.created_date, et.last_modified_by, et.last_modified_date FROM public.external_test et;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwexternaltest TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwexternaltest FROM report_user;
